strings.FAQ_Q1: How are orders dispatched and shipped?
strings.FAQ_A1: Orders are dispatched on business days. The parcel travels in neutral packaging with no indication of the contents or the sender. A lyophilised peptide tolerates normal transit times, so it needs no cold chain in transport — what matters is storage after delivery.
strings.FAQ_A2: The products are intended strictly for laboratory and research use. They are not medicines, food supplements or cosmetics, they hold no authorisation for administration to humans, and we provide no dosing or health advice with them.
strings.FAQ_Q3: How do I read a certificate of analysis (COA)?
strings.FAQ_A3: A COA states the batch number, the test date, the laboratory, the method (typically HPLC for purity and mass spectrometry for identity) and the resulting purity as a percentage. The batch number on the certificate must match the one on the label of your vial.
strings.FAQ_Q4: How should I store a lyophilised peptide?
strings.FAQ_A4: Unreconstituted lyophilised powder is stable long term when kept cold and dark. After reconstitution stability drops considerably and depends on the specific molecule — the parameters for your batch are on the product page under the Storage tab.
strings.FAQ_Q5: How does the discount from 3 units work?
strings.FAQ_A5: The lower unit price applies from 3 units of the same item and is shown in the price list in the “3+ units each” column. For some items (KPV, GHRP-6, Bac Water) no volume price is set — the price list shows a dash instead.
